stop_rules: Treat this as a separate fine-tuning continuation because the completed base checkpoint has no optimizer, scaler, EMA, or early-stopper state.
Keep the frozen NuCLS split, YOLO26n checkpoint, random seed, AdamW configuration, preprocessing, augmentation, inference, and normalization contracts unchanged.
Stop after eight consecutive validation epochs without exceeding the base or continuation best box mAP50-95.
Stop on non-finite loss or validation metrics, after 40 additional epochs, after four wall-clock hours, or before aggregate GPU time exceeds 86400 seconds.
Do not inspect the frozen test fold until validation stopping has settled, and evaluate it once without threshold tuning.
Do not rerun segmentation, train another model, or use the continuation to make a clinical claim.
